dossier.identity: mobile striker of the lumen crew who fires adaptive fans from a scatter rail rifle and wins fights by changing the angle, one dash at a time
dossier.selectionRationale: chosen as the movement-fed striker: a precision streetlight bolt, an adaptive fan that widens into piercing lanes and an alley dash that leaves a decoy, distinct from aria's needle fan, kazuma's blink and astra's dive. the sheet labels moxie a striker, so the role needs no mapping.
dossier.weaponConcept: scatter rail rifle (long-range rail rifle with adaptive spread: twin coolant rails, neon-pink vent fins, a modular scope and stock)

lore.backstory: courier from the rain-soaked lower grid who learned that the shortest route is rarely the straight one. when a crew job went wrong she kept the rail rifle and the rule: never be where the last shot was aimed. she now runs lumen crew's long lanes and picks her angle after the first shot, not before.
lore.syndicateRecord: wanted for four unscheduled rooftop crossings of a corporate checkpoint and for a rail-gun shot that went through three billboards and a delivery drone.
lore.psychProfile: easy-going, restless and quietly precise; talks through a fight like a running commentary, never standing still long enough to be answered.

forms.name: rail lanes

iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Moxie. Theme: better angles. Subject: a bold fan of three bolts bending around a single chunky street corner. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
